title: Mobility and periodic registration update for an emergency services fallback not accepted by the network

entities.name: Mobility and periodic registration update for emergency services fallback
entities.description: Registration procedure initiated by UE for emergency services fallback

entities.name: Abnormal case b failure
entities.description: Specific abnormal case from subclause 5.5.1.3.7 that causes registration failure

entities.name: Abnormal cases c or d failure
entities.description: Specific abnormal cases from subclause 5.5.1.3.7 that cause registration failure

entities.name: Network does not accept registration
entities.description: Network rejection of registration request as described in subclause 5.5.1.3.5

entities.name: No E-UTRA EPC cell selection attempt
entities.description: UE does not attempt to select E-UTRA cell connected to EPC or 5GCN

entities.name: Camped on same PLMN
entities.description: UE is camped on NR or E-UTRA cell connected to 5GCN in same PLMN where last registration was attempted

entities.name: Inform upper layers of failure
entities.description: UE informs upper layers about registration failure for emergency services fallback

entities.name: Abnormal case procedures
entities.description: Procedures defined in subclause 5.5.1.3.7 for handling abnormal cases

entities.name: Network rejection procedures
entities.description: Procedures defined in subclause 5.5.1.3.5 for handling network rejection

relations.description: UE performs procedures from subclause 5.5.1.3.7 when registration fails due to abnormal cases
UE performs procedures from subclause 5.5.1.3.5 when network does not accept registration
Abnormal case b failure triggers UE to inform upper layers of network access failure
Abnormal cases c or d failure triggers UE to inform upper layers when combined with other conditions
Network rejection triggers UE to inform upper layers when combined with other conditions
No E-UTRA EPC cell selection attempt is a condition for informing upper layers
Being camped on same PLMN is a condition for informing upper layers
